Tara (CSM): morning — kicking off prep for Polaris QBR. Need 9 slides: onboarding health, top usage wins, renewal posture, risk radar, enablement asks, runbook. Who can grab slides? Deck: https://redwood.app/decks/polaris-qbr

Ben (AM): I’ll take onboarding + adoption metrics. Pulling 7/30 day funnels and activation rate. ETA Wed 3pm.

Ravi - AE: I’ll handle renewal posture and procurement timeline. Renewal ~52 days. ETA Thu noon.

Noelle Eng: I’ll add runbook + alert snippet and include rollback play. ETA Wed EOD.

Tara (CSM): Please add a one-line exec ask on your slide and link sources.

briefs-bot: Reminder: design review Thu 6pm PT.

Ben (AM): Uploaded slides/03-onboarding-funnel.png and linked analytics. Noted a 15% dip in activation for SDK v2. Flagging as risk.

Noelle Eng: Guardrail snippet added to notes: alert PolarisLatencyP95 expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{team="polaris"}[5m])) by (le)) > 0.13 for: 2m annotations: summary: "Polaris p95 > 130ms". Uploaded slides/08-runbook.pdf.

Ravi - AE: Added renewal slide and three exec asks: 1) approve 30-day Dedicated pilot 2) agree to exec review post-pilot 3) grant procurement support. Tagged reviewers.

Tara (CSM): Quick checklist before dry run: slides named, sources linked, one-line asks, runbook attached. Dry run Wed 7pm PT. If blockers DM me.

briefs-bot: Dry run scheduled Wed 19:00 PT.
